card.name: Ending of kinase inhibitor drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug name that is split up, mostly the 'ib' ending of -tinib drugs such as trametinib, lazertinib and gilteritinib. Also the 'apse' or 'apsed' in relapse and relapsed.

modes.label: -tinib endings
modes.description: The 'ib' that completes a kinase inhibitor name after a stem like trametin or lazertin.
modes.example: TAFINLAR Administered with Trametin<<ib>> (Pediatric) : In the pooled

modes.label: Relapse
modes.description: The 'apse' or 'apsed' that completes relapse or relapsed after 'rel'.
modes.example: rel<<apse>>, putting them at risk for opioid overdose

card.plain: It fires when a drug name like trametinib or the word relapse has just been finished off in its last piece.
